description: The line plot titled "Training Loss of 20M Data Size" illustrates the training loss of various models over a number of steps. The x-axis, labeled "Step," ranges from 0 to 440K, with steps marked at intervals of 20K. The y-axis, labeled "Train Loss," ranges from 0.0 to 0.85, with increments of 0.05. The plot includes six lines, each representing a different model configuration: ChemBART Small 20M, ChemBART Medium 20M, ChemBERTa Medium 20M, ChemLaMA Small 20M, and ChemLaMA Medium 20M. Each line is color-coded and has a unique marker shape and line style. The lines show a general trend of decreasing loss as the number of steps increases, with some fluctuations. The plot does not include any inferred data points or conclusions.
